column1: # Original DICE TV Basketball, play-time potentiometer 35 kOhm (the original default). Start without
# a credit (200 ms); one coin (500 ms) is a two-player game, Start (1500 ms) begins it. Each paddle
# held at both ends alone (1900-3950 ms): paddle 1 moves both striped players, paddle 2 both solid
# players, paddles 3 and 4 move nothing in a two-player game. Recorded closed-loop play (5000-45000 ms,
# the players aim off-center differently in each half) scores for both teams; then the paddles rest.
# Start in play (61500 ms) changes nothing; the timer ends the game; Start without
# a credit after the end (125000 ms); two coins and Start begin a four-player game. Original SDL int16 axes.
